eras.title: Era I
eras.description: Foundation, RMS integration, command center, and automation kernel.

eras.title: Era II
eras.description: Recovery-centered operations, driver workflow, receiving, inventory, and fulfillment workspaces.

eras.title: Era III
eras.description: Enterprise platform, intelligence engine, predictive operations, and production hardening.

builds.title: RMS Integration
builds.description: RMS BOL ingestion, parsing, import, review, and operational source data foundation.

builds.title: Command Center
builds.description: Dashboard, dispatch map, route builder, route assignment, and command-center workflows.

builds.title: Worker Framework
builds.description: Automation worker foundation and worker lifecycle structure.

builds.title: Operational Exception Engine
builds.description: Operational exceptions as filtered operational views rather than separate storage.

builds.title: Automation Safety Patch
builds.description: Queue locking, atomic writes, failure status safety, allowlisted execution, and controlled input validation.

builds.title: Automation Mission Control
builds.description: Automation Center visibility, safe rendering, scheduler state display, and worker status improvements.

builds.title: Scheduler Foundation
builds.description: Scheduler state foundation stored under the operational domain without automatic execution.

builds.title: Queue Integration
builds.description: Scheduler can request existing Automation Queue jobs without running workers directly.

builds.title: Mission Control Controls
builds.description: Operator controls for scheduler pause, resume, and run-now queue request creation.

builds.title: Policy Engine
builds.description: Automation policy layer for deciding which job types are automatic, blocked, or approval-required.

builds.title: Execution Controller
builds.description: Safety controller for deciding whether queued automation jobs may execute.

builds.title: Executor Integration
builds.description: Executor requests authorization before worker invocation and records blocked/authorized lifecycle states.

builds.title: Automation Background Service Host
builds.description: Automation host state and health surface without threads, timers, or daemon processes.

builds.title: Automation Kernel Certification
builds.description: Architecture, lifecycle, host, Mission Control, audit, and stress certification of the Automation Kernel.

builds.title: Recovery Center Foundation
builds.description: Recovery route, stop, component count, totals, and estimated weight business foundation.

builds.title: EOMS Design System
builds.description: Reusable Windows/Edge-style layout, sidebar, topbar, CSS, JS, and demo workspace.

builds.title: Recovery Workspace
builds.description: First operational Recovery Workspace using the EOMS Design System.

builds.title: Recovery Workspace Live Data
builds.description: Recovery Workspace connected to existing route and store records through read-only adapters.

builds.title: Driver Portal Foundation
builds.description: Driver Workspace foundation with assigned route, stop, component totals, and estimated weight display.

builds.title: Driver Workspace Stop Detail
builds.description: Driver stop detail panel with store, BOL, origin, address, contact, component fields, and notes.

builds.title: Driver Count Save
builds.description: Driver-entered component counts and notes save to existing store records and update Driver/Recovery totals.

builds.title: Complete Stop Workflow
builds.description: Saved driver stops can be completed as Recovered with progress and completion metadata.

builds.title: Driver Exceptions
builds.description: Driver exception reporting for recovery stops, including notes-required validation and Recovery visibility.

builds.title: EOMS Roadmap Workspace
builds.description: Internal development dashboard for EOMS roadmap, progress, standards, and future planning.

builds.title: Receiving Workspace Foundation
builds.description: Warehouse receiving visibility for recovered loads after driver recovery completion.
builds.notes: Receiving records place recovered material into warehouse receiving without implementing inventory management.

builds.title: Inventory Workspace Foundation
builds.description: Inventory visibility after receiving is defined, with component-level stock surfaces.
builds.notes: Inventory stock is calculated from received loads with warehouse adjustment support.

builds.title: Fulfillment Workspace Foundation
builds.description: Outbound fulfillment planning after receiving and inventory foundations are stable.
builds.notes: Fulfillment reserves available inventory and records outbound shipments.

builds.title: Reporting Workspace Foundation
builds.description: Executive read-only reporting workspace across completed EOMS operational domains.
builds.notes: Reporting workspace provides read-only executive visibility across completed operational domains.

builds.title: Command Center Modernization
builds.description: Modernize the main Command Center into the executive control center for completed EOMS domains.

builds.title: AI Operations Assistant
builds.description: AI recommendations that become governed automation jobs rather than direct execution.

builds.title: Predictive Dispatch
builds.description: Predictive routing, exception risk, dispatch timing, and operational forecasting.

builds.title: Enterprise Operations Platform
builds.description: Enterprise-grade logistics operating system across dispatch, warehouse, fleet, GPS, analytics, and governed AI.
